ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across 98% of the surface area; macro-level ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels is estimated at approximately 0.02:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Surface is characterized by a nearly uniform solid dark-gray to black distribution; lacks distinct contiguous geometric blobs; presence of diffuse, non-contiguous white pixel speckling across both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The central depression is a deep U-shape with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 48 degrees between the medial margins of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entire continuous linear boundary; peaks and valleys are irregular, with more pronounced jaggedness on the distal half of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent convex sweep from the notch to the tips; the left lobe distal edge shows a secondary concave indentation near the tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized cluster of high-contrast, multi-tonal white and tan pixels on the extreme distal tip of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (thin white streaks) are visible on the medial-lower region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A cluster of external organisms (likely barnacles) is attached to the trailing edge of the right fluke tip; a distinct V-shaped notch is visible on the distal tip of the left lobe.
